notes: Read all 52 source lines line by line before editing; preserved the MapLayerSwitcher export, current/onChange prop names and signature, the MapStyle union, and the four-entry layers table (dark/satellite/streets/terrain) with identical ids, emoji icons, and labels.

L1 clsx and L19/L35 className string composition are replaced by React Native StyleSheet array composition; L2 imports MapStyle from ./MapTileLayer which is not yet ported to native, so the identical union type is defined and re-exported here to keep the native contract in sync.

L18-29 floating absolute Leaflet overlay div is ported to an absolutely positioned View (bottom/left/zIndex 1000, row, gap, rounded border, glass surface, shadow) using theme tokens; backdrop-blur has no RN primitive so the semi-transparent surfaceGlass token approximates the overlay intent.

L30-49 button map preserves per-layer key, onPress=>onChange(l.id), title becomes accessibilityLabel, active (current===l.id) vs inactive styling (surfaceRaised+textPrimary vs transparent+textSecondary), and the web hover state maps to a Pressable pressed state plus accessibilityRole=button and accessibilityState.selected.
L46-47 icon span renders always and the L47 `hidden sm:inline` label is preserved via useWindowDimensions against Tailwind's 640px sm breakpoint so labels stay icon-only on narrow native viewports.

Web-only `forced-colors`/Windows High Contrast wrappers (L21-27, L37-40) have no React Native equivalent; native renders always-visible solid token-based colors and borders instead, so no forced-colors state is required. No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported.
